page.layout: One page of text, with a woodcut ornament below the text block and a catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: Obtrectatorum clamores nihil moror, ad quos iampridem & obsurdui & occalui. Bene vale in Domino.
Genevæ ex Musæo nostro Calendis Ianuarij anno vltimi illius temporis MDXVIII. ineunte, qui vtinam piis & bonis omnibus felix illuxerit.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below the text is not transcribed. The date "cIↄ Iↄ xviii" is read as MDXVIII under the reversed-C rule; the printed form is partly worn. The catchword "GENE-" is set in spaced capitals at the lower right.
